book.name: MARCOS
book.title: Marcos' pilla Diosa' mika ura kuinda

content: Nazaret pebulunu chumulaJesúsnu meengui'la.
Jesús junu pu' miitu, ya' awanu pebulusha miintsuñu, ya' disipulula bain yaba bulu jila.

Tsejtu saaduma lekanu malu chayañu, cha' waku wakudinu yasha vi' Diosa' palaa mijakaantsumi. Tsenñu junu wa'na' meenamu chachilla mika meenbashindu tsa tsandila: ¿Tsen, entsa unberee nukaa tsaa demijatundin? ¿Maa yanu tsaa aseetaju pensa kuñanga? ¿Tsenmin naa ketaa tiba tsamantsaa ke' keewara juula bain kiiketunguen? tiitila.

¿Entsa María' na, kaapinderu taawasha kemu ruku jutyuu, naa Santiagochi bain, Joséchi bain, Judaschi bain, naa Simónchi bain ya' naatala jutyuu? ¿Tsenmala naa ya' tsujkila bain lala' pebulunun dechutyuu? tiitila. Tsanditu Jesúsnu jayuuba ya' kuindanu meenguityu jujuula.

Tsa deeñu, Jesús tsandimi: Diosa' mitya pamu rukula vee mujtu nenduya balenguramu deeve, tsaaren ya' chunu tusha bain, naa ya' bulula' kejtsapala bain, naa ya' chunu yasha bain chumu chachillachiya balenguratyu deeve, timi.
Tsejtu Jesús, junuya tiba tsamantsaa ke' keewara jumula ke' keewarendyu'ba, dilulanuya ya' tyaapachi ta'ka' mallee ura' mandiremi.

Tsejtu Jesús mika keenbashi' puimi, junu chumu chachilla yanu jaiba dekerangui'ñu' mitya. Jesús ya' 12 disipululatyee kenu deeñuba wandi' eemi. (Mateo 10.5-15; Lucas 9.1-6) Jesús, Nazaret keetala kaa pebulu chumulanu Diosa' palaa mijakares neneimi.
Tsejtu bene yachi 12 disipululanu demikatu pallu pallu vele', nukaba de-eekemi, Dioschi urajtu kuraa tiremu bu'chullalanu me-e'laanuu bain detiretu.
Tsejtu mindala menestenguikenuu juulaya ti bain ta'tyudei tituren, tyutyan cha'liya main ta'dei, timi. Tsa' mitya ti buusa juu bain, naa pan juu bain, naa lushi juu bain, jayuuba ta'tyudei, timi.
Tsaaren sandalia juuya pu' jidei tituren, bene manbannu vera jali juuya ta'nu mandangui'mi.
Tsejtu tsandimi: Naaju yanu viji' bain juntsa pebulunu malu' miji'mujchiya juntsa yanun chudei.

Tsaaren nukaaba ñullanu demikatyu', naa meedinu tya bain de-i'shu juntsaa, junu malu' miidei, tsai' malu' miindu ñulla' neepanu mai'dimu ujtupe demangasha'pukidei, tsanguetaa Dioschi urajtu chachi dekure' taaju inu detsuve ti' keewaanu, timi.
Tsenñu ya' disipulula delu' jitu Jesús' mitya kuinda wandis neneila: Veta' pensa demangue' Diosnu meranguidei, tiititu.
Tsejtu naa dyabululanu bain pure' me-e'laakes ne', naa dilulanu bain muli yuutsure' pure' ura' mangues neila.
Juan Mungaamu peñu kuinda

Chachilla Jesúsnu laapu' patu naa naadetiñu bain rei Herodes kuinda meemeekemi, matyu Jesús' kuinda nukaba den meejantsuñu' mitya. Tsenñu mantsa chachillaya: Entsaya Juan Mungaamu millaa mangujñuve, tsa' mityaa naa tiba tsamantsaa ke' keewara juu bain ke' keewaawaakive, tiitila.
Tsenmala veelaya: Entsaya Diosa' mitya pamu ruku Elíasve, tiitila. Tsenmala kayu veelaya: Kaspee tinbunu Diosa' mitya pamu rukula jun tsaave, tiitila.
Tsa tsa detiñu, Herodes meetu tsa tsandimi: Juntsaya Juanve, iya mishu daapukare' tu'kaakeeshu juntsa ruku, challa mangujtu iñuve, tiitimi.
Matyu Herodesya, Herodías' mityan Juannu peesu kakare' jeru chuwachi teetsuukaakemuwaami. Tsaaren Herodesya ya' naatala Filipo' shinbu jumu Herodíasnun, tsaa ya' shinbu mandirekemuwaami,
tsenñaa Juan, reinu tsa tsandimuwaami: Ñu' naatala' shinbunun ñu' shinbu majuu tananu jutyuve, tiitimuwaami.
Tsenñu' mityaa juntsa shinbu Juannu ajaatya' tu'nu tyaturen, naake' tuten tsaa jujuuwaami,

matyu reiya Juannu jeemuwaami, yaa Dios naakesa tyañuba tsanguen chumu ruku juñu, naa Dioschin juu chachi juuñuba mi' mitya, tsenmin yanu tiba ikaan jutyu yaa washi washikemuwaami. Tsejtu Juan ule' pañu meenamiya ti ken tsai tiya tiyaimu ju' bain, meenanchiya meenanu ajchuu juwaami.

Tsejturen Herodías naake' tuten tsa tsandyantsuren, rei ya' nakayanu malu manchañu ya' balen chachillanu bain, naa suutadu amalanu bain, naa Galileasha chumu kayu bale chachillanu bain demikake' panda fikaantsumi.

Tsenñu tsangue' panda findetsuñu, Herodías' na'ma vi' junu panda fimula' ajuusha beelanguemi. Tsai' beelanguiñu rei yuj sundyami, naa yaba bulu chudi' panda fimula bain yuj sundyala. Tsai' sundyatu rei juntsa na'manu tsandimi: Ñu ti mujñuba inu pa'ka, tsenmala iya kuwanu tsuyu, timi.
Tsejtu Diosnu paka' uwain tsanguenbera kenu tsuyu ti': Ñu ti pa'ñuba kuwanu tsuyu, titu, in chachillanu ma tsandaaya washkenu tirenu tsuyu, tiitimi.
Tsandiñu juntsa na'ma junu malu' miitu ya' amanu, ¿Tyee pa'nu juwa? tita jimi. Tsenñu ya' ama tsandikami: Juan Mungaamu' mishpukaa pa'de, timi.
Tsandiñu juntsa na'ma rei' junga te' mijiitu tsandimi: Juan Mungaamu' mishpukaa challaren palatunu puu kuwasa tenve, timi.
Tsandiñu rei yuj llakindyami; tsejturen, ya' mikañu jamu chachilla' ajuunuren, Diosnu paka' tsanguenbera kenu tsuyu ti' mityaa, naati' tsanguen jutyuyu tin tsaami.
Tsa' mitya ma suutadunu jeke Juan' mishpuka taade ti' eemi. Tsenñu juntsa suutadu peesusha ji' Juannu mishu daaka'
ma palatunu puu taji' juntsa pannanu kuwami, tsenñu ya' amanu kuwami.
Juntsaiñu Juan' disipulula kuinda demijatu junga ji' Juan' ujkun bulu manga' menjila.
5.000 pullaa chachillanuJesús panda fikaami.
Jesús' mitya kuinda kenu lara' eramu rukula Jesúsba demawa'dijitu, titi dekes ne' bain, tyee demijakares ne' bain wainla.

Tsenñu Jesús yalanu tsandimi: Muba bulla kennatyuinsha mi'ke' jayu lekanu jidaa, timi. Matyu yala nuka dejiñu bain chachilla bendala sureita ne' naa pandaba fikaanu kityu juju deeñu' mityaa, Jesús tsandimi ya' disipululanu.
Tsandi' mitya Jesús ya' disipululaba kaa baakunu vi' yai tene juu muba bulla kennatyuinsha jila.
Tsa-i' jindetsu pure' chachilla keenatu keengala, tsejtu nuka pebulu' chulla bain delu' jei dejitu, yala' jinu tenasha yalaa ajke' ji' keenala.
Jesús ya' jinu baakusha pu' tusha lutu, chachilla tsamantsadena katatu yuj tenbityami, matyu uvejaaba deju' washkes neneimu ruku miyajtu juuñu deeñu' mitya. Tsejtu ti bain pure' mijakaakemi.
Jesús tsanguentsuren yumaa dekependu' kakentsuñu, ya' disipulula Jesúsnu kalen jitu tsandila: Entsa tenaa tiba den chutyuin tenanuren yumaa ma kepeindetsuyu.
Tsa' mitya kumuinchi entsa chachillanu deme-eenu kide, tsenmala yala endaa kalen chunu yatala deji', tsaityu' bain kalen chun pebulutalaaba deji' tiiñuba ka' finudetsu, tila.

Tsenñu Jesús tsandimi: Ñullaa yalanu panda kuwadei, timi. Tsenñu yala tsandila: ¿Tsen naa ketaa lala yalanu millangue fikaanbera pan kanu dejuwa? Entsa panda fikaraya, ma añu tingumake taawasha kikeñuu balenu juve, tila.
Tsenñu Jesús tsandimi: ¿Nan pan detanayu? Ji' keekidei, timi. Tsandiñu yala ji' keetu: Pan manda, alla pallu tadenayu, tila.
Tsa detiñu kumuinchi chachillanu jayu jayu debuute' lushkatata ishtapetala dechudikaadei, timi.
Tsenñu 100 chachi buudi' chudina' bain, 50 chachi buudi' chudina' bain tsa tsaila.

Tsenñu Jesús ya' tyaapachi pan bain manda ka', alla bain pallu kakitu, kai'sha ke'laadi' Diosnu yuj urave titu, pan dedaaka' ya' disipululanu kuwami, kumuinchi chachillanu veenudetsu. Tsejtu allanu bain tsarenguemi.
Tsenñu kumuinchi chachilla tyubanbera fila.
Tsejtu naa pan llujpe laramula bain, naa alla llujpe laramula bain mande'katu, 12 kubi ma seranguila.
Tsaaren junu panda fimula unbee rukulan juuren 5.000 ma juula.
Jesús pi jandala nemi.
Tsangue' depuitu Jesús ya' disipululanu baakusha dema-eepumi juntsa pusu bejkusha Betsaida pebulu pi keesha yalaa ajke' demanbuisa tyatu; tsaindetsuren yaa junu wa'namu chachillanu deme-eren pumi.
Tsangue' chachillanu deme-ere' dyatu kuyisha Diosba kuinda kenu jimi.
Tsejtu yumaa dekependu'kanu uwatala, ya' disipulula' miinu baakuya yumaa juntsa pusu pi kejtala miintsun, Jesúsya tusha shuwa' maali pumi.

Tsanatu Jesús ya' disipulula miindetsu ishuwa masmi' juyintsuñu, yanmula yuj taaju' kendetsuñuba kata-eemi. Tsejtu dechanusha Jesús pi jandalaren sake' yala' junga miji' tsaa ne dapullanchi iintsuñuimi.
Tsenñu ya' disipulula pinu ma neintsu dekata-eetu, ujmaaba tsaintsumee tya' dewatitila,
yala katandene kideke' dewapana' mitya. Tsenñu Jesús yalanu jeti entsandi-eemi: Puluke pensanguidei, iyaa tsaintsuyu. Jeetyatyudei, timi.
Tsejtu Jesús tsa-i' baakusha maviñu, ishuwa mandyami. Tsenñu ya' disipululaya yuj keenbashintsula,
matyu yalaa naake' aseetanguen tsa deju', kaspele bain pan jayun juunuren tsamantsangue seewaañuba aseetanguindetyu' mitya.
Genesaretsha dilu chumulanuJesús ura' mandiremi.
Juntsa-i' aa pusu bejkusha detyakatu Genesaret tushaa tyuinajila, tsejtu yala' baaku deteetsure' lula.
Tsenñu nei'ba tusha delunmalan chachilla Jesúsnu mangueengala.
Tsejtu Jesús nuka puve detiñu mija' bain kumuinchi jundaa chumu chachillaya Jesús' puinsha, dilulanu wandunu tsuu taji tajiila.

Tsejtu nuka Jesús jiiñu bain, naa kaa pebulusha jiiñu bain, naa aa pebulusha jiiñu bain, naa jeenbaatala jiiñu bain miñutala dilulanu taji' tsutsungaala. Tsejtu Jesúsnu ka naa jai kapanuuñuba ta'kakutide ti' u'ta u'tandila. Tsanditu naajula bain ta'kamulaya ura' mandiya mandiyaila.
